notes.title: Update 1.7 Beta is here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41654498/b2e23465aaac1cf12d587492fe8d91eaeea532b0.png[/img]

Hi all,

Update 1.7 Beta for The Midnight Wind is now live! The leadup to the ciimax of the story has been added.

Update includes:

-Three new enemies, and two new boss battles!
-Raja Ketua is now recruitable!
-New skills for characters added
-Some bug fixes

The ending of the game is coming...update 1.8 Beta will be the final beta version available!

notes.notes:
Hi all,

Another quick update for The Midnight Wind. This one adds two custom backgrounds, adds Titania's character quest, and makes some slight changes to the Caves.

notes.title: We're back!
notes.notes:
After 2 years, development of The Midnight Wind has resumed! Highly obscure vaporware shall become a highly obscure game.

Updates include:

Continuation of the main story, including a new siege event!
A horror character!
Two new character quests, for Grizzly and Mind Chick!
18 new enemies!
More weapons and armor! I didn't count how many. 

Thank you for your attention!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41654498/1f03e8f600bf6d950e44bdb076dae14073ce3c9c.png[/img]

notes.title: The Midnight Wind WILL return
notes.notes:
Howdy to the void,

I'm returning to developing The Midnight Wind quite soon, after I release my newest project this summer. A new update will come in August/September.

notes.title: Update 1.3 Beta is live!
notes.notes:
Hi all, after some delay the latest update to The Midnight Wind is here! It took a lot of time because my laptop was broken for a month(I tripped and fell on it), but it is fixed now! 

This update adds a quest log of 20 different quests, so players can keep track of what to do in the game. A new game over screen has replaced the old one, one that I think is more true to form with the games spirit. 

Thank you all!

notes.title: 1.2 Version Releasing Soon
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

The paid 1.2 Version of The Midnight Wind is releasing soon, and will bring a slew of new features into the game! This version will receive regular updates with no price change until the full version releases. The free version will remain up for a couple more months or so.
 
This version will include:
- Access to the Midnight Wind version Beta 1.2
-5 new locations to explore, including a new city.
-16 new enemies to encounter
-Challenger's Wall; a place to encounter more powerful versions of bosses.
-The continuation of the story arc
-Yanfly's animated sideview enemies plugin! Eventually, all enemies will become animated.
-Yanfly's EquipCore for increased ease of use of the equipment system
- A few bug fixes
-New music tracks for existing and new areas.

NOTE: Save files for the demo version may not carry over to this version. You may have to start fresh.

Thank you for your time!
